document.abstract: An optical/mechanical unit containing a 16mm film camera which couples to a TV camera through a common zoom lens is described and illustrated. The direct film recording system, named Gemini, is used throughout the world to record television programs for distribution, thus eliminating the problem of multiple television standards. The system is becoming increasingly important for the filming of programs in color using black-and-white television cameras.
